name: Sheep Shearer Kirsty

intro.text: Two hundred sheep a day, one at a time, the old way. Sore back, quick hands. Let's see how fast you shear a battle.

win: A fast fight. You've the hands for the shed.
after: A good shearer can shear a sheep in a couple of minutes. Shearing sheds ring with the sound of the clippers all summer.
